definition: Improve a bad or unsatisfactory situation.
example: Extra support helped ameliorate the effects of isolation.
nuance: Ameliorate is formal and commonly concerns conditions or harmful effects.
prompt: A policy addresses poor living conditions.
options: The reforms can ameliorate conditions by improving access to clean water.
The reforms ameliorated conditions by making them worse.
Ameliorate meant to preserve every existing problem unchanged.
The policy ameliorated conditions simply by describing them.
reasons: Better access improves the unsatisfactory situation.
Worsening is the opposite of improvement.
Preserving problems does not improve them.
Description alone does not improve conditions.
